_meta.description: Tax per tonne on landfill and incineration in Catalonia (where the demo runs): the state tax of Ley 7/2022 at Catalan rates. Applied only to the materials and routes listed. National Ley 7/2022 rates are lower (10 €/t landfill and 4 €/t R01 incineration for this kind of waste) and are kept for reference.

rows.name: Landfill tax (Catalonia 2026)
rows.source: Decret llei 3/2026 (Catalonia), annex A) 3-4: landfill of non-municipal non-hazardous waste, 2026 rate

rows.name: Incineration tax, R1 energy recovery (Catalonia)
rows.source: Decret llei 3/2026 (Catalonia), annex E) 3: incineration with energy recovery (R01) of non-municipal waste
rows.notes: Flat 15 €/t through 2031. Applies to the energy-from-waste routes; biomass and RDF go to co-incineration, which is taxed at 0 €/t (annex G).
